chunksweeper.config.title: Chunk Sweeper
chunksweeper.config.pruneOnWorldExit.too: After "Save and Quit to Title", removes the chunks nobody has spent time in. Minecraft generates them again if someone goes back there.
chunksweeper.config.exitSummarySeconds.t: How long the number of removed chunks stays on the "Saving world" screen.
chunksweeper.config.overwriteBackups.too: Keeps a single <world folder>.zip in the backups folder that is replaced every time, instead of adding a new dated zip. Handy if that folder is synced to the cloud.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.chunksweeper: Removes unused chunks to make worlds and backups smaller.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.chunkswee: Removes unused chunks from singleplayer worlds when you leave them and from the backups made in the Edit World screen. Based on the Thanos library by Aternos.
